name: Mortgages
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of mortgaging property during times of need, as seen in Nehemiah where people mortgaged lands and houses to buy food. It warns believers to live wisely and prudently, managing resources with diligence to avoid becoming servants to lenders, reflecting the truth that the borrower is servant to the lender. God's blessing and guidance are promised to those who meditate on His law and live righteously, which leads to prosperity and success. Ultimately, righteousness is exalted, while sin brings reproach, underscoring the importance of faithful stewardship in all financial matters.
